description: This file defines traits and objects for computing correlation metrics, including correlation coefficients and matrices, within the Spark MLlib library. It includes interfaces for correlation algorithms, implementations for delegating correlation computations based on method names, and maintains supported correlation types.

classes.name: Correlation
classes.description: Trait defining methods for computing correlation between datasets and matrices.

classes.name: Correlations
classes.description: Object that delegates correlation computations to specific algorithms based on method names.

classes.name: CorrelationNames
classes.description: Object maintaining supported correlation method names and default settings.

methods.name: computeCorrelation
methods.description: Abstract method to compute correlation between two RDD[Double] datasets.

methods.name: computeCorrelationMatrix
methods.description: Abstract method to compute the correlation matrix for an RDD of vectors.

methods.name: computeCorrelationWithMatrixImpl
methods.description: Default implementation combining two RDD[Double] into a matrix and computing correlation.

methods.name: corr
methods.description: Delegates correlation computation for two RDD[Double] datasets based on specified method.

methods.name: corrMatrix
methods.description: Delegates correlation matrix computation for an RDD of vectors based on specified method.

methods.name: getCorrelationFromName
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation object corresponding to a method name, throws exception if unrecognized.
